concepts.title: Apache Spark
concepts.summary: Unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing.

concepts.title: Daft
concepts.summary: Distributed Python DataFrame library with a Unity Catalog integration.

concepts.title: Apache DataFusion
concepts.summary: Extensible, high-performance query engine in Rust using Apache Arrow.

concepts.title: delta-rs
concepts.summary: Native Rust implementation of the Delta protocol with Python bindings.

concepts.title: Delta Spark
concepts.summary: The reference Delta connector for Apache Spark (`io.delta:delta-spark`).

concepts.title: Delta Lake
concepts.summary: Open table-format specification: ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time travel over object storage.

concepts.title: DuckDB
concepts.summary: In-process analytical SQL engine.

concepts.title: DuckDB delta extension
concepts.summary: DuckDB extension that reads Delta tables and appends to them.

concepts.title: DuckDB iceberg extension
concepts.summary: DuckDB extension that reads and writes Iceberg tables and attaches Iceberg REST catalogs.

concepts.title: DuckDB unity_catalog extension
concepts.summary: DuckDB extension that attaches a Unity Catalog server as a database and reads and writes its tables.

concepts.title: Envoy
concepts.summary: Open source edge and service proxy; the gateway that routes requests to each service.

concepts.title: Iceberg REST Catalog
concepts.summary: Open specification for an Iceberg catalog served over REST: engines use it to create, load, and commit Iceberg tables through any conforming catalog.

concepts.title: iceberg-rust
concepts.summary: Rust implementation of Apache Iceberg with REST catalog and table APIs, and a DataFusion integration.

concepts.title: Iceberg Spark runtime
concepts.summary: Apache Iceberg's Spark integration: Iceberg tables and catalogs, including REST catalogs, in Spark SQL and DataFrames.

concepts.title: Apache Iceberg
concepts.summary: Open table-format specification for huge analytic datasets, with hidden partitioning and snapshot isolation.

concepts.title: Catalog
concepts.summary: The metadata authority: a registry of tables, schemas, and access that every query resolves through.

concepts.title: Credential
concepts.summary: A catalogued cloud identity the catalog uses to mint scoped storage credentials.

concepts.title: Storage credential issuer
concepts.summary: The storage provider's identity plane that mints short-lived credentials narrowed to a path and operation.

concepts.title: External location
concepts.summary: A governed object-storage path, paired with the credential that can reach it.

concepts.title: File format
concepts.summary: The on-disk encoding of the bytes a table's data files are made of.

concepts.title: Function
concepts.summary: A governed, reusable unit of computation.

concepts.title: Governance
concepts.summary: Decides who may access what, and enforces it (row filters, column masks).

concepts.title: Catalog metadata store
concepts.summary: The database a catalog keeps its metadata in, so the catalog server itself holds no catalog state.

concepts.title: Metric view
concepts.summary: A view that declares measures and dimensions, so every engine computes a metric the same way.

concepts.title: Model
concepts.summary: A governed ML model.

concepts.title: Model tracking
concepts.summary: Tracks experiments, versions models, and governs their promotion to production.

concepts.title: Namespace
concepts.summary: The namespace container other asset kinds are organized under.

concepts.title: Object storage
concepts.summary: Stores data as flat objects (blobs) addressed by key, not as a file hierarchy.

concepts.title: Query engine
concepts.summary: Parses, plans, and executes queries over open table formats.

concepts.title: View
concepts.summary: A named query over tables, resolved and run by the query engine.

concepts.title: Table
concepts.summary: The tabular securable — rows and columns with ACID semantics.

concepts.title: Open table format
concepts.summary: A metadata layer that gives object-storage files ACID table semantics.

concepts.title: Volume
concepts.summary: A governed directory: a catalog name for a storage path that holds files, usually non-tabular.

concepts.title: MLflow
concepts.summary: Open source platform for the ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment.

concepts.title: Apache Parquet
concepts.summary: Open columnar file format: column-wise storage with compression and statistics, the data-file layer most table formats are written in.

concepts.title: Polars
concepts.summary: Fast DataFrame library written in Rust, with a Python API.

concepts.title: PostgreSQL
concepts.summary: Open source relational database; the metadata store behind catalog and tracking services.

concepts.title: PyIceberg
concepts.summary: Python implementation of Apache Iceberg with REST catalog and table APIs.

concepts.title: RustFS
concepts.summary: S3-compatible object storage server written in Rust.

concepts.title: S3 API
concepts.summary: The de-facto object-storage interface.

concepts.title: unitycatalog-ai
concepts.summary: Python client library for registering and executing functions through Unity Catalog.

concepts.title: unitycatalog-anthropic
concepts.summary: Anthropic integration that turns Unity Catalog functions into tool definitions for the Messages API.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog CLI
concepts.summary: Command-line client for managing Unity Catalog objects and storage access.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog Delta API
concepts.summary: Open specification for catalog-managed Delta tables over REST: an engine negotiates the protocol version, stages and creates a table with the table features the catalog requires, and commits through intent-based updates guarded by preconditions, all or nothing.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog Java SDK
concepts.summary: Generated synchronous Java client for Unity Catalog REST APIs.

concepts.title: unitycatalog-langchain
concepts.summary: LangChain integration that turns Unity Catalog functions into tools an agent can call.

concepts.title: unitycatalog-openai
concepts.summary: OpenAI integration that turns Unity Catalog functions into Chat Completions tool definitions.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog Python SDK
concepts.summary: Generated asynchronous Python client for Unity Catalog REST APIs.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog (OSS)
concepts.summary: The open-source reference server implementing the Unity Catalog specification.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog Spark connector
concepts.summary: Spark catalog plugin that resolves tables, views, and credentials through a Unity Catalog server.

concepts.title: Unity Catalog
concepts.summary: Open catalog specification for data & AI: a catalog governing tables, files, functions, and models across engines.
